test_overview: The regression test for the pilot logbook application (localhost:8000) passed all 7 steps with no failures. The server was accessible and correctly seeded with the Pilot account "Regression Pilot" (pilot.regression@example.com). Step 1: Login redirected / to /login, succeeded, and aircraft N900REG (Cessna 172S, Airplane/SEL, all flags unchecked) was created with Active status. Step 2: Add Flight form showed the "Lesson flight" checkbox (checkbox-lesson-flight) defaulting to OFF and enabled; the non-lesson flight for 2026-07-09 (D_minus_30) saved successfully with valid time sums; the logbook row displays "—" in the Lesson/Endorsement column (not a lesson, N/A endorsement), and only Edit/Delete actions exist with no signing action present. Step 3: Edit form confirmed fields are editable; the lesson checkbox is disabled with helper text "Lesson status cannot be changed after saving" and an attempted click could not toggle it (checked remained false before/after); notes updated to "Regression flight - edited", saving succeeded, and the updated notes were verified by reopening the edit dialog; the flight remained non-lesson. Step 4: The Lessons/Endorsements filter verified: "Lesson only" showed an empty list, "Signed only" remained empty, and "All flights" restored the flight row. Step 5: Analytics (Last 90 Days covering D_minus_30 to D0) Overall Totals matched: Total 1.5h, PIC 1.5h, Night 0.5h, XC 1.5h, Actual Inst 0.5h & Sim Inst 0h, Approaches 6, Day TO/Ldg 1/1, Night TO/Ldg 1/1; Category/Class grouping showed the same under "Airplane - SEL". Step 6: Currency verified on the Analytics page — Day/Night (window 2026-05-11 to 2026-08-08) for Airplane - SEL both "Not Current" with TO 1/3 and Ldg 1/3; Instrument (window 2026-03-01 to 2026-08-31) for Airplane "Current" with Approaches 6/6, Holds ✓, Intercept/Track ✓. Step 7: Export CSV produced logbook.csv containing standard MVP columns plus the endorsement columns LessonFlight, EndorsementStatus, ActiveEndorsementInstructorName, ActiveEndorsementInstructorLicense, ActiveEndorsementSignedAt (ISO 8601), EndorsementCount; the flight row had LessonFlight=false (lowercase booleans used consistently throughout), EndorsementStatus empty, instructor fields empty, EndorsementCount=0. All verification logs saved to /app/_verification_logs/. Final score: 52/52.

steps.description: test_pilot_login_and_aircraft_creation: Login as seeded Pilot succeeded (email unique identifier per PRD, redirect to /login followed) landing on the Pilot logbook view. Aircraft N900REG / Cessna 172S, Category Airplane, Class SEL, all flags unchecked, created successfully and listed in Active state (status shown as Active and later selectable in the Add Flight form). Passed - 6/6.

test_log_non_lesson_flight_with_validation: Add Flight form shows a 'Lesson flight' toggle (checkbox, checkbox-lesson-flight) defaulting to OFF. All fields filled and saved successfully (Day 1.0 + Night 0.5 = Total 1.5 accepted). Flight appears in logbook dated 2026-07-09 and is NOT marked as a lesson. (non-fatal sub-verification passed) Endorsement column shows an em-dash meaning blank/not applicable. No Instructor signing action exists for the row (only Edit/Delete), so signing cannot be initiated. Passed - 10/10.

test_non_lesson_flight_is_editable_and_immutable_lesson_status: Edit form opened; flight fields are editable (night time modified and restored). Lesson status is immutable: checkbox disabled on edit with note 'Lesson status cannot be changed after saving'; attempted click could not toggle it. Notes edited to 'Regression flight - edited' and saved; updated notes verified as 'Regression flight - edited' (this UI exposes notes only via the edit dialog); flight remained non-lesson. Passed - 6/6.

test_logbook_filters_with_non_lesson_flight: Lessons/Endorsements filter dropdown applied: 'Lesson only' yielded an empty list; 'Signed only' remained empty; returning to 'All flights' made the non-lesson flight row reappear. Matches the PRD All/Lesson only/Signed only filter equivalents. Passed - 6/6.

test_analytics_totals: Analytics Time Period 'Last 90 Days' inherently includes 2026-07-09 through 2026-08-08. Overall Totals verified (non-fatal, all correct): Total Time 1.5h, PIC 1.5h, Night 0.5h, Cross-country 1.5h, instrument time shown separately as Actual 0.5h and Simulated 0h, Approaches 6, Day TO/Ldg 1/1, Night TO/Ldg 1/1. Category/Class grouping showed the identical metrics under 'Airplane - SEL' (non-fatal, correct). Passed - 6/6.

test_currency_calculations: Currency section (part of the Analytics & Currency page) verified for Airplane SEL (non-fatal, all correct): Day currency within 90-day window TO 1/3 | Ldg 1/3 with 'Not Current' badge; Night currency TO 1/3 | Ldg 1/3 with 'Not Current' badge; Instrument currency for Airplane over the 6-calendar-month window (2026-03-01 to 2026-08-31) shows Approaches 6/6, Holds checked, Intercept/Track checked, and status 'Current'. Passed - 10/10.

test_export_includes_endorsement_columns: Exported CSV (all flights) contains standard MVP columns (Date, Registration, Make/Model, Category, Class, flags, times, counts, approaches, Holds, Intercept/Track, Notes) plus the new endorsement columns LessonFlight, EndorsementStatus, ActiveEndorsementInstructorName, ActiveEndorsementInstructorLicense, ActiveEndorsementSignedAt (ISO 8601), EndorsementCount. The flight row (Date 2026-07-09, N900REG) has LessonFlight=false (lowercase booleans used consistently across the CSV), EndorsementStatus empty, instructor fields empty, EndorsementCount=0. Passed - 8/8.
